## DeepSeek Harness

`lib/format.mjs` bundles the unmodified session format catalog and its format migration/validation helpers from DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**, source tag `dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2`, commit `687f282e8625c6b8d11ff58211a90524be2e4317`. This is used to validate complete cold-restorable history before any live mutation. Source: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness . MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 DeepSeek; full license: [LICENSE.DSH](LICENSE.DSH).

Cordis, the Session and LLM SDK, React, and native UI components are provided by the matching installed host and retain their respective licenses. Build dependencies are declared in package.json.
